rationale: Checked at 2026-09-26T14:44:15Z against PLAN §1/§6/§8, VERIFICATION G1, all 14 evidence files, STATE.json, LOG.md, SPEC-01/02/03/04/05/07, the harness and DB scripts, and the app code. No discovered fact invalidates the data or verification strategy: the source is Neon PG 16.15 with exactly the four Drizzle tables, plpgsql only, GAP_START 1,000,000 correctly derived from max id 174, identity 171/171 against live /api/blog, inventory and fingerprints independently re-derived byte-identical with the final scripts, pg_dump/pg_restore 16.15 proven in the Sandbox, the harness approved after five rounds with 22/22 mutation cases and a 288-URL baseline with zero exhausted retries. The evidence supports its claims; the one G1 failure (Task B) is a real tooling defect whose fix is now in the working tree at scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs:131-156 but is proven only by its author, hence condition C4. Three plan assumptions are invalidated and must be amended precisely: the Neon target (sin1, not iad1; region immutable; owner authorized a new DB and upgraded to Launch), so a new iad1 resource co-located with iad1 functions is the right call, with a newer PG major accepted because a 16 dump restores into 17/18 and the reverse path is row-level JSON, guarded by a P4.1 collation check; the DNS runbook, because www carries the replit-verify TXT that forbids a CNAME at the same name, so the switch must use an A record; and the apex, where the baseline (301 to http://www) meets SPEC-05's own Step C criterion while the harness's fixed post-cutover expectations already assume the apex moves. I also found an app-level nondeterminism the plan does not anticipate: created_at ties across 89 of 171 published posts with no secondary sort key, which can surface as text diffs after the restore; it is handled without a code change via a local pre-check and a strictly conditioned allowlist class. Plan change A (compact manifest) is approved with self-test and mixed-mode requirements; plan change B is resolved as measurement and cache proof rather than app code. Nothing here risks data loss or downtime for proceeding to P2 and P3 in parallel under the single-writer rules, so the verdict is GO_WITH_CONDITIONS; conditions C1-C4 gate P3.2/P4.1, C5-C7 and C12 gate P6.3/A2, C8-C10 shape P2.2/P5.2/P6.2, and C11 governs the parallel run.
